title: IT Support Executive
description:
**Role purpose**

Provide daily IT troubleshooting and employee support, maintain asset and support records, and assist with

approved account, device and cybersecurity checks. Troubleshooting is the primary requirement; additional

cybersecurity and data skills are advantages.

**Key responsibilities**

* IT and Microsoft 365 support: Troubleshoot Windows, laptops, desktops, Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel,

OneDrive and SharePoint, including desktop and browser applications.

* Devices and connectivity: Set up and troubleshoot printers, scanners, IP phones, extensions, LAN, Wi-Fi and

internet connections.

* Ticketing and location coordination: Record, prioritize and follow up IT requests with location POCs, maintain

updates and confirm resolution.

* Onboarding, offboarding and reassignment: Configure employee devices and approved accounts, manage

equipment handovers and returns, and coordinate access changes.

* Accounts and workstation audits: Handle approved account, mailbox, permission and license changes. Check

Windows users, password and PIN setup, screen locks, software and device protection; coordinate password

updates according to company policy.

* eBMS coordination: Work with department heads on approved user creation, permissions and account reviews.

Track issues, follow up pending cases and verify fixes.

* Asset management and maintenance: Verify equipment, maintain employee and location assignments,

perform preventive checks, and track warranties, repairs and replacements.

* SIMs, subscriptions and invoices: Maintain SIM ownership, user, plan and roaming records. Track licenses,

renewals and assigned invoices; flag unused services and unusual charges.

* Updates, backups and cybersecurity: Check updates, antivirus, MFA and assigned backups; identify and report

phishing or suspicious activity, and assist with approved security checks under IT supervision.

* Signatures and directory: Check and update approved email signatures, employee contact details,

departments, locations and extensions.

* Documentation and reporting: Maintain setup guides, troubleshooting notes and handover records. Submit

weekly updates on pending issues, assets and renewals.

**Required skills**

* Practical knowledge of Windows, Microsoft 365, hardware, printers, scanners and basic networking.
* Ability to use remote support tools and maintain accurate Excel and ticket records.
* Basic knowledge of phishing, MFA, endpoint protection and safe account access.
* Good communication, organization and follow-up skills.

**Additional advantages**

* Cybersecurity coursework, certifications or practical projects, and basic data analysis skills.
* Exposure to Microsoft 365 administration, eBMS, IP phones, asset registers or ticketing system

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

* Health insurance

* Trouble shooting: 1 year (Required)

Language:

* Malayalam (Required)

Location:

title: IT SUPPORT ENGINEER( GCC Client Support Remote)
description:
**IT SUPPORT ENGINEER – L1 (REMOTE GCC CLIENT SUPPORT)**

We are seeking a customer-focused and technically competent **IT Support Engineer – Level 1 (L1)** to provide remote technical support to our clients across the GCC region, primarily the UAE. The role will be based at our India office in Athani, Kochi, Kerala, and will involve handling first-level technical issues related to IT systems, CCTV and surveillance systems, wireless access points, and general IT infrastructure.

The ideal candidate should have good troubleshooting skills, a service-oriented mindset, and **excellent English communication skills**, as the role requires regular communication with GCC clients, particularly UAE-based customers.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide L1 remote technical support to UAE and GCC clients.
* Troubleshoot basic computer, hardware, software and system-related issues.
* Provide support for CCTV cameras, NVRs, DVRs and surveillance systems.
* Troubleshoot wireless access points, Wi-Fi and basic network connectivity issues.
* Communicate effectively with clients in English through calls and emails.
* Record support requests, follow up with clients and escalate complex issues to the technical team.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* Diploma or Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, Networking or a related field.
* Minimum 1–2 years of experience in IT support, technical support or L1 support.
* Basic knowledge of IT systems, networking, CCTV systems, IP cameras and wireless access points.
* Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal, to communicate with UAE/GCC clients.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Good customer service, coordination and follow-up skills, with the ability to handle and resolve support requests efficiently.

**Work Location & Employment Details**

* Location: Athani, Kochi, Kerala, India.
* Work Arrangement: Office-based role in India, providing remote technical support to clients across the GCC region.
* Client Region: UAE and other GCC countries.
* Support Level: Level 1 (L1) technical support.
* Salary: Competitive and negotiable based on experience, technical knowledge and suitability for the role. Salary expectations can be discussed during the interview.
* Employment Type: Full-time.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to support UAE-based clients and GCC technology projects.
* Practical exposure to IT infrastructure, networking, CCTV and wireless technologies.
* Opportunities to develop technical troubleshooting and customer support skills.
* Professional growth within a UAE-focused IT and system integration business.
* A collaborative work environment with opportunities to learn from experienced technical teams.
* Competitive salary based on market standards, experience and capability.
* Career progression opportunities based on performance and technical development.

If you are interested, please share the CV to \*info@infrasmartme.com

Or WhatsApp the CV to 050 416 8600 (Please don’t call).

**The selected right candidate will get attractive salary and benefits based on the industry standards.**

Visit the company website: www.infrasmartme.com for more information.

title: Networking, ELV Systems & Technical Support Trainee
description:
**Networking, ELV Systems & Technical Support Trainee**

Are you passionate about electronics, networking, and technology? Do you enjoy troubleshooting, solving technical problems, and learning by doing?

Baker & Grey invites applications for three Networking, ELV Systems & Technical Support Trainee positions. This is a hands-on opportunity for candidates with a sound technical foundation who want to develop their skills through practical experience with real-world technology systems.

**What You'll Work On**

* Networking: Installation, configuration, and troubleshooting of IP-based devices, routers, switches, firewalls, and related networking equipment.
* ELV Systems: Installation, configuration, and troubleshooting of CCTV, access control, audio-video solutions, communication systems, alarm systems, and related ELV technologies.
* System Design: Equipment selection, floor-plan interpretation, system layouts, and basic Bill of Quantities (BOQ) preparation.
* Technical Support: Fault diagnosis, practical problem-solving, and technical documentation.

**Who Can Apply?**

* Diploma or degree holders in Electronics, Electrical, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related disciplines.

**Prerequisites:**

* Candidates must have a sound existing knowledge of electronics and electrical fundamentals, including voltage, current, basic electrical connections, electronic components, and the safe and correct use of a multimeter.
* Candidates must have basic computer hardware and software knowledge, including operating system installation, software configuration, PC hardware maintenance, and troubleshooting.
* Candidates should have a strong interest in technology, logical thinking, practical problem-solving skills, and a willingness to learn independently.

**Important:** This is not a classroom-based training programme. Candidates are expected to possess the fundamental knowledge required for the role and develop further skills through practical assignments, independent learning, and guidance from experienced professionals.

**Programme Details**

* **Duration:** 3 months
* **Stipend:** Provided throughout the programme
* **Learning Approach:** Hands-on experience, supervised technical assignments, and mentoring
* **Career Opportunity:** The best-performing candidate(s) may be offered permanent employment based on technical competence, responsibility, learning ability, and business requirements.

*Permanent employment is not guaranteed upon completion of the programme.*

**Job Details**

title: Executive – IT Support
description:
**Company:** KLM Axiva Finvest Ltd.  
**Location:** Corporate Office, Edappally, Kochi  
**Department:** Information Technology (IT)  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Job Summary**

KLM Axiva Finvest Ltd. is looking for a proactive and technically skilled Executive – IT Support to provide technical assistance to corporate office employees and branches. The role involves troubleshooting hardware and software issues, resolving branch-level technical complaints, guiding branch staff on hardware-related queries, and ensuring the smooth functioning of IT infrastructure across the organization.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide technical support to corporate office employees and branches for hardware, software, and system-related issues.
* Handle hardware-related queries from branches, clarify technical doubts, and guide branch staff in troubleshooting and resolving issues.
* Diagnose and resolve issues related to desktops, laptops, printers, scanners, biometric devices, and other IT peripherals.
* Coordinate with branches to identify technical problems and provide timely solutions through phone, remote support, or on-site visits when required.
* Arrange hardware repair, replacement, or vendor support for issues that cannot be resolved remotely.
* Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot computer systems, operating systems, and business applications.
* Troubleshoot LAN, Wi-Fi, internet connectivity, and other basic network-related issues.
* Coordinate with hardware vendors, service providers, and other stakeholders to ensure timely issue resolution.
* Maintain records of IT complaints, service requests, troubleshooting activities, and resolutions.
* Monitor IT assets and maintain accurate records of hardware inventory, allocation, and movement.
* Ensure timely resolution of technical complaints to minimize operational downtime and business disruption.
* Support IT infrastructure upgrades, new system installations, and other technology-related activities.

**Educational Qualification**

* Bachelor's degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Applications, or a related field.
* Relevant technical certifications will be an added advantage.

**Required Skills**

* Good knowledge of computer hardware, peripherals, and troubleshooting techniques.
* Basic understanding of networking, internet connectivity, and Windows operating systems.
* Ability to explain technical solutions clearly to non-technical branch employees.
* Strong problem-solving, communication, and coordination skills.
* Ability to manage multiple support requests and ensure timely closure.
* Willingness to coordinate with branches and travel for technical support when required.

**Experience**

Freshers with relevant technical knowledge may apply

title: Service Desk Coordinator
description:
**Job Title:** ServiceDesk Coordinator (Helpdesk coordinator)

**Location:** Kochi

**Job Summary:**

The Service Desk Coordinator is responsible for overseeing and coordinating the day\-to\-day activities of the IT service desk or help desk team. They play a key role in ensuring that customer issues and technical support requests are addressed promptly and efficiently.

**Main Responsibilities:**

**Team Supervision:**

· Manage a team of service desk technicians or support staff.

· Provide guidance, coaching, and training to team members.

· Monitor team performance and ensure adherence to service level agreements (SLAs).

**Ticket Management:**

· Receive, prioritize, and assign service requests and incidents to appropriate team members.

· Ensure accurate and timely documentation of all tickets.

· Monitor ticket queues to ensure timely resolution and escalation as needed.

**Customer Support:**

· Act as the point of contact for customers and end\-users seeking technical assistance.

· Respond to customer inquiries and resolve technical issues promptly.

· Maintain a high level of customer satisfaction through effective communication and problem\-solving.

**Process Improvement:**

· Identify opportunities to improve service desk processes and workflows.

· Implement best practices to enhance efficiency and customer service.

· Document and update standard operating procedures (SOPs).

**Technical Knowledge:**

· Stay up\-to\-date with IT industry trends and technologies.

· Provide technical guidance and expertise to team members when needed.

· Assist with complex technical issues and escalations.

**Reporting and Metrics:**

· Generate reports on service desk performance, including ticket volumes, response times, and resolution rates.

· Analyze data to identify trends and areas for improvement.

· Prepare regular reports for management.

**Vendor and Asset Management:**

· Manage relationships with IT vendors and service providers.

· Assist in procurement and asset management activities as necessary.

**Security and Compliance:**

· Ensure compliance with security policies and procedures.

· Assist in incident response and security\-related tasks as required.

**General Responsibilities:**

· Maintain and update configuration documents.

· Maintain assets and software licenses/subscriptions.

· Vendor coordination and support

**Qualification:**

· Graduate or above

· 1\+ years of total experience

· ManageEngine service desk application (Optional)

· Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word)

Familiarity with the ITIL (Information Technology Infrastructure Library) framework is a plus.

**Skills:**

· Handling any service desk ticketing tool.

· Ticket registration via Phone and email

· Logging and categorization of tickets

· Assign the engineers.

· Prepare and submit monthly reports.

· Maintain SLAs and do timely escalations.

· Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word)

· Ability to speak and write clearly and accurately in English.

Application Question(s):

* How many years of experience? ( 1\-2yrs)
* What is your current ctc?
* What is your Expected ctc?
